title: Trim remaining lesson notes from the lead memory index
body: Outcome: the lead MEMORY.md index holds operator preferences, grants and decisions only (target about 600 tokens; 5888 bytes after #213). Unmarked lesson notes remain, e.g. codex-exec-dispatch-pitfalls, host-disk-housekeeping, krn-ci-fleet-egress-drift, codex-hook-stdout-json-rule, krn-ship-archives-worktree-runs, review-attempt-admission, bg-daemon-mcp-baseline: mark each 'Lesson pending enforcement: <id>' or move it to a check, lead-rules line or ~/AGENTS.network.md, then delete it; memory-refs PENDING-LESSON keeps them visible.
